subject: MorphOS Version Ambient ARexx ABI

rexxMessage.derivation: RexxMsg begins with Exec Message (20 bytes), followed by rm_TaskBlock and rm_LibBase (4 bytes each); the listed fields follow in order as 32-bit values/pointers.

officialSdk.callerProvidedBase: Candidate calls rexxsyslib vectors with an invocation-local A6 base; it does not write an SDK static library-base field into shared resident image data.

functions.name: DoARexxCmd
functions.behavior: Open rexxsyslib.library V36, create a reply port and RexxMsg, put VERSION in rm_Args[0], send RXCOMM | RXFF_RESULT to the AMBIENT port under Forbid/Permit, wait for and consume the reply, copy a successful result into MEMF_ANY storage, and release owned resources.

functions.name: makeambientversion
functions.behavior: Save pr_WindowPtr, set it to -1, query AMBIENT, parse major.revision with DOS StrToLong, set the local Ambient variable and print the Ambient component; if that fails, try ambient_path and the two built-in Ambient executable paths; restore pr_WindowPtr.

candidateEvidence.behavior: Implements the ARexx request, reply copy, major.revision parsing, local Ambient variable, source output/result behavior, and owned-resource cleanup. Uses explicit caller-provided A6 vector calls to preserve shared image state.

limits: The Ambient executable providers using ambient_path, MOSSYS:ambient/ambient, and SYS:System/ambient/ambient remain unimplemented.
Supplied-vector qualification does not replace execution against an original MorphOS guest or PURE/resident lifecycle, licensing, and package admission evidence.
